test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Ravi walks 10 meters towards the north, then turns right and walks 10 meters. He again turns right and walks 10 meters. Which direction is he facing now?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Ravi starts walking towards **North**.

Walks 10 meters → Facing North

Turns right → Faces East and walks 10 meters

Turns right again → Faces South and walks 10 meters

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63606a9fa78504a46a178685f664a597bfba79a608a03931261fb2dda920bb01.png] 

So, finally Ravi is facing **South**.

Hence, the correct answer is** Option 2.**
